opportunities.title: Scale Celvane’s D2C E-Commerce Growth
opportunities.description: Project Title: E-Commerce Growth Strategist & Performance Marketer to Scale Celvane to ₹5 Lakhs/Month (Prepaid + COD) Project Overview: Celvane (fashion & lifestyle brand) is looking for an experienced e-commerce growth strategist and media buyer to build, launch, and optimize our acquisition funnel to reach ₹5,00,000 in monthly gross merchandise value (GMV) with a balanced 50% Prepaid / 50% COD split. Key Deliverables: 1. Store Conversion & Checkout Optimization: - Audit and optimize the storefront (Shopify/lightweight stack) for maximum mobile conversion rate (target: 2.5%+). - Integrate an Indian payment gateway (Razorpay/Cashfree) with 1-click UPI checkout. - Configure COD verification and risk filters (OTP verification / automated WhatsApp confirmation) to restrict Return-to-Origin (RTO) below 20%. 2. Paid Customer Acquisition (Meta / Instagram Ads): - Build, launch, and manage Advantage+ Sales Campaigns on Meta. - Conduct creative testing for 10–15 short-form video hooks (Reels/UGC styling formats). - Maintain a minimum target blended ROAS of 3.0x to 3.5x. 3. Retention & Order Recovery Automation: - Set up automated WhatsApp sequences for abandoned carts and prepaid incentives (e.g., offering an instant ₹100 discount to convert COD orders into prepaid). - Implement post-purchase tracking updates to reduce delivery refusals. Requirements: - Proven track record scaling Indian D2C fashion or lifestyle brands to ₹5L+ monthly GMV. - Deep expertise in managing COD cash flow and mitigating RTO losses. - Please share live case studies or dashboard screenshots showing verified ROAS and ad spend. Budget & Structure: - Fixed monthly retainer + tiered performance bonus based on delivered net revenue milestones.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40806995, publicado hace 3 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 20,000 - 100,000.

opportunities.title: Client Acquisition Executive for Web Projects
opportunities.description: Details In Short: We need an experienced commission-based Business Development / Client Acquisition Executive who can get us new clients. Duration: 1 month to 1.5 month (15 nov - 31 dec) Budget 10,000rs (In milestones, 2000rs per converted client, converted client project value should be above 5000rs) Target: 5 paying clients. Payment will be released in milestones, one for each successful conversion. Prefered Freelancer: In Indian, who understand local language and demand, and how to talk to potential client, has done similar work before, deal with client in professional manner. Previous experience in sales, business development, lead generation or client acquisition is preferred. Languages: Hindi, english or both Target Locations: Mandsaur,MP Nimach, Manasa, Jaora, Ratlam, Targeted Clients: people who need portfolio websites, small business like beauty parlors, gyms, etc looking for their online presence, people who need website or an app. We are interested in businesses and individuals who need an online presence or digital solutions. Examples include: ⦁ Beauty parlours and salons. ⦁ Gyms and fitness centres. ⦁ Restaurants and cafes. ⦁ Local shops and small businesses. ⦁ Professionals who need portfolio/personal websites. ⦁ Businesses looking for website development. ⦁ Individuals or businesses requiring custom applications. Responsibilities ⦁ Research and identify potential clients. ⦁ Find businesses through Google Maps, social media and other platforms. ⦁ Contact potential clients through calls, WhatsApp, social media or cold emails. ⦁ Understand their business requirements and identify opportunities. ⦁ Present our website and application development services. ⦁ Explain the proposed solution and communicate with potential customers. ⦁ Follow up with interested prospects and handle initial negotiations. ⦁ Convert interested prospects into confirmed paying clients. We will provide the necessary service details, pricing information and proposals to help you pitch our services. What you will do: 1. find potential clients. 2. reach them. 3. understand their business and give details to me. 4. I'll make demo screens and details and send to you. 4. pitch them offer and shows demo 5. Payment is done after they agree to make full project with us 6. Keep track in spreedsheet of Businesses contacted, Interested prospects, Meetings, discussions arranged, Proposals sent, Paying clients acquired. Definition of a Successful Conversion A client will be considered successfully converted when ⦁ The client agrees to proceed with a development project. ⦁ The project requirements and pricing are confirmed. repeat the process for 5 clients.

Standard PLA or TPU is not suitable for this purpose. Please let me know about your direct experience printing silicone or other soft-touch elastomers, the hardware you’ll be using, and any post-processing you provide (e.g., curing, trimming, surface finishing). If shipping is required, I’m in the [provide your location] region; factor that into your turnaround so we can hit the “within a month” window. Deliverable: one fully cured, production-quality massage bar prototype that matches the supplied STL exactly.

opportunities.title: 2D Human Sprite Walk & Crawl
opportunities.description: I already have a rough concept for a human-style 2D character and now I need all of the movement animations brought to life directly inside Blender. The focus is simple: a complete set of walk cycles in every cardinal and diagonal direction, plus matching crawl cycles in those same directions. No extra attacks or idles—just fluid, game-ready locomotion. What I expect from you • A clean Blender file containing the rig and finished animations. • Exported PNG sprite sheets (or individual frames, if you prefer) for each direction of both the walk and crawl cycles, ready to drop into my engine. • Consistent frame counts and timing across every direction so I can swap animations without hiccups. I’ll supply the character reference, palette, and exact frame size once we start. If you’ve handled multi-direction 2D rigs in Blender before, this should be a straightforward assignment. Looking forward to seeing the character finally move!

opportunities.title: AI Bot development issues
opportunities.description: I'm developing an AI bot for private use and need to refine its design and user experience. Key improvements needed: - Streamlining the bot's functionality for efficiency - Enhancing overall design for better usability **Title: cTrader C# Developer Needed to Audit and Align an Adaptive Demo and Live Trading Bot** I’m looking for an experienced cTrader Automate/C# developer to investigate and fix differences between my cloud demo bot and local live-account bot. The project is **Jye Gold V8 Adaptive**, currently used for **XAUUSD on five-minute candles with Pepperstone**. I have the existing source code, compiled builds, parameter exports, journals, test results and saved local learning checkpoints. **The main problem** The demo and live versions were intended to use the same adaptive strategy, with the additional account permissions needed for live trading. In practice, their behaviour and results have differed. The live bot has sometimes opened and closed trades within seconds, including taking very small profits or losses. Logs show that some of these exits came from the model deciding its expected edge had faded or reversed, rather than the trailing stop being hit. I need the developer to establish whether those decisions are correct, whether the forecasts are being applied consistently, and why the demo behaves differently. **What has already been identified** - The demo and live instances have separate learned model states. Copying the strategy code and parameters did not transfer the demo’s accumulated learning. - An earlier exit-buffer change was applied only to the live version. That change was subsequently removed, and the latest live candidate’s decision engine was matched to the demo engine and checked with replay tests. - Other repairs have addressed quote changes during saving that cancelled entry attempts, a delayed trade-closure/checkpoint issue, and position ownership problems caused by shared labels between bot copies. - Local learning restoration has been implemented and observed working through restarts of the same instance. - The cloud demo’s model is currently held in memory for that run. A verified export and durable recovery mechanism for its exact learned state remains unresolved. These are the recorded findings so far. I want the current installed versions and native logs audited, rather than assuming every earlier issue is still present or that all repairs are fully proven. **What I need done** 1. Compare the actual demo and live builds, parameters, model states and execution paths. 2. Reproduce the rapid exits and explain the precise entry and exit decisions, including conflicting short- and longer-horizon forecasts. 3. Check candle timing, tick updates, bid/ask prices, spread, commissions, slippage and execution delays. 4. Establish a reliable model-only export/import process where supported. Keep account-specific positions, orders and ownership records separate. 5. Verify restart recovery, duplicate-order prevention and isolation between multiple instances. 6. Preserve the intended stop-loss, trailing-stop and sizing behaviour. Any strategy changes should be clearly explained and tested against the baseline. 7. Reconcile results using this bot’s confirmed trades and net results after costs, separately from manual trades and unrelated account history. **Deliverables** I want a clear root-cause report, corrected source and compiled package, a documented list of changes, and reproducible test evidence. Given identical model state and market inputs, the strategy decisions should match; genuine broker/execution differences should be explained. Initial testing should use simulation or demo. Live activation will remain under my control. Please include your relevant cTrader/C# experience, how you would investigate this, and separate estimates for the initial audit and subsequent fixes. I’m looking for reliable, measurable engineering work—not a promise of guaranteed profits. Source code and redacted supporting records can be provided privately. Ideal Skills and Experience: - Expertise in AI bot design - Strong background in UX/UI design - Experience in optimizing bot interactions Looking for a freelancer who can ensure my AI bot is user-friendly and visually appealing. It’s currently demo trial has had great results but the live trial seems to be not working the same the project has been developed with chat gpt and vis code on ctrader platform

opportunities.description: Necesito un profesional que desarrolle el paquete completo de planos para una casa de una sola planta en un terreno inferior a 150 m². Requiero que el juego incluya: • Arquitectura: plantas, cortes, fachadas y cuadro de áreas • Estructura: cimentación, detalles de losas, vigas y columnas, con memorias de cálculo básicas • Instalaciones: esquemas y planos de electricidad, hidráulica y sanitaria con su respectiva simbología Entrego el programa de necesidades y las medidas exactas del predio una vez iniciado el trabajo; espero retroalimentación sobre distribución y soluciones constructivas antes de cerrar la versión final. opportunities.description: Estamos buscando traffickers digitales, especialistas en performance marketing y afiliados independientes que quieran generar ingresos mediante la captación de clientes interesados en servicios de cementerio, funerarios, cremación y sepulturas. Buscamos personas o agencias con experiencia en campañas digitales, generación de leads calificados y adquisición de clientes, que puedan desarrollar estrategias comerciales orientadas a resultados. Canales de adquisición: * Meta Ads: Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads y campañas de generación de leads. * Google Ads: Search, Performance Max, Display y YouTube Ads. * TikTok Ads: campañas de captación y generación de demanda. * SEO y posicionamiento orgánico: captación de clientes mediante búsquedas de alta intención. * WhatsApp Marketing: estrategias de conversión y derivación de prospectos. * Email Marketing y automatizaciones: captación, remarketing y recuperación de oportunidades. * Marketing de afiliados: redes de referidos, sitios web, comunidades digitales y plataformas de generación de demanda. ¿Qué buscamos? Personas con experiencia en adquisición digital que puedan gestionar sus propias campañas, identificar oportunidades comerciales y generar prospectos con intención real de contratación. El modelo de colaboración estará orientado a resultados, con comisiones por ventas efectivamente concretadas, según el producto y las condiciones comerciales acordadas. ¿Qué ofrecemos? * Oportunidad de generar ingresos mediante comisiones por ventas. * Portafolio de servicios con demanda permanente. * Posibilidad de colaboración comercial de largo plazo. * Modelo de trabajo flexible e independiente. * Potencial de crecimiento según resultados y volumen de ventas. ¿Te interesa participar? Si tienes experiencia gestionando campañas en Google Ads, Meta Ads u otros canales de adquisición y buscas monetizar tus habilidades en marketing digital, queremos conocerte. Escríbenos indicando tu experiencia, canales que gestionas, volumen de leads que puedes generar y modalidad de trabajo. ¡Buscamos aliados estratégicos para potenciar la generación de demanda y nuevas oportunidades comerciales!

opportunities.title: Layout PCB vi điều khiển
opportunities.description: Tôi đang hoàn thiện một mạch điều khiển dùng vi điều khiển; sơ đồ nguyên lý đã xong nhưng danh sách linh kiện vẫn còn vài vị trí cần chốt. Board phải đọc cảm biến, điều khiển relay hoặc động cơ, có kết nối không dây (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth hoặc 4G) và hiển thị trạng thái qua màn hình, nút bấm cùng đèn báo. Những gì tôi cần từ bạn: • Kiểm tra lại schematic hiện tại, đề xuất hoặc xác nhận linh kiện trước khi sang bước layout. • Bố trí và định tuyến PCB tối ưu (2–4 layer tuỳ đề xuất) bảo đảm: – vùng RF sạch cho module không dây, – đường công suất đủ rộng cho relay/motor, – cách ly nhiễu tốt cho khối cảm biến. • Giao bộ file hoàn chỉnh: file thiết kế (Altium hoặc KiCad), Gerber/NC Drill sẵn sàng sản xuất, BOM cập nhật, bản PDF/3D preview và vị trí test-point gợi ý. • Hướng dẫn ngắn về lắp ráp và kiểm thử để tôi chuyển tiếp cho xưởng. Bạn từng layout board tích hợp không dây và tải công suất nhỏ sẽ là lợi thế lớn. Vui lòng kèm vài dự án tương tự và thời gian hoàn thành dự kiến khi gửi đề xuất.

opportunities.title: Round Perfume Bottle CAD Design
opportunities.description: I’m creating a new luxury fragrance line and need a production-ready CAD model for its signature perfume bottle. The vision is distinctly round or softly curved to feel elegant in the hand, with a bespoke cap that complements the silhouette. Here’s what I’m looking for: • A fully detailed 3D CAD file (STEP or IGES preferred) of the bottle and custom cap, ready for mould tooling. • Basic engineering drawings with overall dimensions, wall thickness recommendations, and parting lines indicated. • A few photorealistic renders that show how the glass and cap will look in clear, frosted, and tinted finishes so I can share visuals with branding and marketing. You’re free to choose the platform that suits you best—SolidWorks, Rhino, Fusion 360, or similar—as long as the output is clean and manufacturable. If you’ve designed fragrance or cosmetics packaging before, please mention it; experience with glass tolerances and cap fitment is a big plus. Once awarded, I’ll supply logo artwork, target fill volume, and any regulatory marks that need to sit on the base. I’d like to review an initial concept within a few days, iterate once or twice, and then receive the final files. Looking forward to seeing your design skills bring this luxury bottle to life.

opportunities.title: Santa Reindeer Flight Animation & Textures
opportunities.description: Hi! I have a Santa with sleigh and reindeer scene, I need animation and textures converted. Looking for one person to tackle both issues in a single pass, and to work with long term as go-to 3D specialist. • Animation Create a smooth, simple, seamless, loopable “flying through the sky” cycle—Santa in the sleigh, reins tight, reindeer legs pumping and bodies bobbing naturally. Animations must follow certain criteria that I require. • Texture conversion Currently the textures use a legacy/non-PBR work flow, including spec/reflection maps. I need the textures converted into standard PBR workflow with ORM maps and renamed as required. Deliverables – Clean .max file with the new animation applied – All converted textures, neatly organized and linked – A quick viewport or playblast preview so I can review timing before final hand-off Acceptance criteria 1. The flight loop plays endlessly without visible pops or foot-slide. 2. Opening the .max file triggers zero missing-map warnings. 3. File paths are relative so the project relocates without breaking. If you’re comfortable animating characters and fixing PBR/legacy texture inside 3ds Max, this should be a easy, straightforward, fun task. Looking to get this completed ASAP, ready to chat more to provide reference and further detail. Thanks!

opportunities.title: Restore My WhatsApp History
opportunities.description: I need a specialist who can help me retrieve the complete chat history from my own WhatsApp account. The last backup sits in Google Drive, and I still have full access to both the Google account and the original WhatsApp phone number linked to it. Your task is to guide me through—or directly perform—the restoration so every message, photo, video and attachment contained in that backup appears intact on my phone. I want the recovered chats to load seamlessly in WhatsApp, not just as an exported text file. You should already be comfortable working with Google Drive backups, Android or iOS device storage (depending on what you recommend for the safest path), and any auxiliary tools needed to verify data integrity. Clear, step-by-step communication is essential because I’d like to understand what you’re doing and why, and have confidence that my data remains private throughout the process. When we’re done I expect to open WhatsApp and see the full conversation history exactly as it existed at the time of the backup. If any issues arise—partial restores, missing media, or conflicts with existing data—you’ll troubleshoot until everything is complete.

opportunities.title: Scalable AI Business OS Automation
opportunities.description: Looking for an experienced developer to build an automated, scalable AI Business Operating System using GoHighLevel, n8n, Stripe and AI integrations. Required Features: * AI phone receptionist (24/7 answering, lead qualification and bookings). * AI chatbots, WhatsApp, SMS and email automation. * CRM and automated lead management. * Social media content creation, scheduling and management. * SEO and AI Search Optimisation (AIO). * Automated funnels and lead generation. * Business workflow automation. * Stripe subscriptions and payments. * Automated client onboarding and account creation. * Client and internal admin dashboards. * Automated reporting and system monitoring. Critical Requirement: BUILD ONCE, DEPLOY REPEATEDLY. New customers must automatically receive their configured platform using reusable GoHighLevel snapshots, n8n workflows and industry templates. No manual rebuilding for each customer. The system should support multiple industries and hundreds of businesses with minimal human involvement. Budget: I am a startup with a strict budget. Cost is a major deciding factor. Prioritise existing tools and cost-effective solutions over unnecessary custom development. If you cannot deliver within your proposed budget, please do not bid. When applying, provide: 1. Total development cost. 2. Estimated timeframe. 3. Ongoing monthly costs. 4. Relevant portfolio and experience. 5. Proposed architecture and development approach. I require ownership of custom source code, workflows and documentation. Open to milestone-based development.

opportunities.title: Smooth Logo Animation Variations
opportunities.description: I already have the finished logo artwork as a PNG and now need it brought to life. The goal is an about 8-second sequence with moving parts and smooth motion—clean, polished, and perfectly suited for use as the opener to my video intros and presentations. Deliverables • Animated logo in original colour on transparent/alpha • Same animation on a plain white background • Same animation on a plain black background • Preferred formats: 1920×1080 (or higher) MP4/H.264 for all three, plus a ProRes or MOV with alpha for the transparent version. The editable project file is a bonus. The animation should resolve by roughly the 6-second mark, then hold for the remaining couple of seconds so the logo is clearly visible before cutting away. Subtle sound design is welcome if you feel it enhances the piece, but it isn’t mandatory. opportunities.title: Verified Texas B2B Decision-Maker Leads
opportunities.description: We are a Texas-based technology consulting company seeking an experienced B2B lead generation and market research specialist to build a highly targeted, accurate, and verified prospect database. Our company provides managed IT services, fractional CTO/CIO leadership, cybersecurity, Microsoft 365, cloud infrastructure, compliance consulting, and business automation. We are not interested in bulk email lists, scraped databases of questionable quality, or generic contact information. We require 500 qualified organizations with at least one verified, named decision-maker email per organization and up to two contacts per organization. This project may lead to ongoing work as we expand into additional geographic markets. 1. Target Industries Research organizations located in the San Antonio and Austin, Texas metropolitan areas. Industry Target Organizations Churches and Ministries 200 Healthcare / Medical / Dental Practices 100 CPA and Accounting Firms 75 Nonprofits and Private Schools 75 Professional Services Businesses 50 Total 500 Ideal Organization Profiles Churches and Ministries * Prefer 250+ weekly attendees * Multi-campus churches are highly desirable * Churches with dedicated administrative, technology, media, or operational departments * Target Executive Pastors, Operations Directors, Church Administrators, and IT Directors Healthcare * Independent medical and dental practices * Approximately 5–100 employees * Target Practice Administrators, Owners, and Operations Directors CPA and Accounting Firms * Approximately 5–75 employees * Target Managing Partners, Firm Administrators, and Owners Nonprofits and Private Schools * Approximately 10–200 employees * Target Executive Directors, School Administrators, and Technology Directors Professional Services * Approximately 10–150 employees * Legal, engineering, architecture, consulting, and similar firms * Target Owners, Managing Partners, COOs, and IT Directors Organizations outside these ranges may be included only when there is a documented reason they are a strong technology-services prospect. 2. Mandatory Email Verification — Strict Requirements NO CATCH-ALL EMAILS. NO GENERIC EMAILS. NO UNVERIFIED EMAILS. Every accepted contact must have a verified professional email address belonging to a named individual. Accepted * Named decision-maker with a professional business email * Email classified as valid/deliverable by a reputable verification service * Publicly verifiable association between the contact and organization * Verification result, provider, and date documented Not Accepted * Catch-all or accept-all email domains * Generic inboxes such as info@, office@, admin@, contact@, or support@ * Personal Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail, Outlook.com, or similar addresses * Invalid, risky, unknown, or unverified emails * Guessed email addresses without successful verification * Duplicate contacts or organizations * Contacts who no longer work at the organization * Purchased bulk lists without individual research and verification Email verification must be performed using ZeroBounce, NeverBounce, or an equivalent reputable service. A catch-all email is unacceptable even if it appears valid or is publicly listed. Any organization without at least one qualifying, verified decision-maker email will not count toward the required 500 organizations. Do not send unsolicited test emails to validate addresses. 3. Required Data Fields Provide the following information in an Excel workbook and Google Sheets-compatible format. Organization Information 1. Unique organization ID 2. Organization name 3. Industry and subcategory 4. Website URL 5. City, state, and ZIP code 6. Public business phone number 7. Estimated employee count or organization size 8. Number of locations or campuses, if available 9. Organization qualification notes Decision-Maker Information 10. Full name 11. Job title 12. Professional business email 13. Email verification status 14. Email verification provider 15. Email verification date 16. LinkedIn or official staff profile URL, if available 17. Contact source URL 18. Contact research date Sales Qualification 19. Primary technology service opportunity 20. Recommended service category: Managed IT, Cybersecurity, Fractional CTO/CIO, Cloud/Microsoft 365, or Automation 21. Lead priority score (1–100) 22. Brief explanation supporting the score Do not invent organization size, technology needs, or contact information. Mark unavailable optional information accordingly. 4. Required Deliverables The final submission must include: * 500 unique qualified organizations * At least 500 verified, named decision-maker contacts * Up to 1,000 contacts where two qualified individuals can be identified * Excel workbook with separate organization, contact, research evidence, and QA tabs * Google Sheets-compatible version * Clean CSV files suitable for GoHighLevel CRM import * Source URLs and verification dates * Email verification results and provider information * Summary of research methodology and quality-control results Data must be standardized, properly formatted, and free of duplicates. 5. Quality Standards and Acceptance Criteria The following standards are mandatory: * 500 accepted organizations in the agreed geographic markets * 100% of accepted organizations have at least one qualifying named business email * Zero catch-all, generic, personal, invalid, or unverified email addresses in the accepted deliverable * 100% of accepted emails have documented verification results * At least 95% accuracy in industry classification * At least 90% accuracy in decision-maker role relevance * Zero duplicate organizations * 100% of accepted records include research source URLs and dates We will manually audit a sample of records at each milestone. Records that fail the acceptance requirements must be corrected or replaced at no additional cost. All research must use lawful methods and comply with applicable data privacy requirements and source-platform terms. 6. Project Milestones The project will be divided into four milestones: Milestone 1 — Paid Pilot * 50 fully researched organizations * At least one verified decision-maker per organization * Email verification evidence included * Client review and approval required before proceeding Milestone 2 * 150 additional qualified organizations * Complete verification and research documentation Milestone 3 * 150 additional qualified organizations * Complete verification and research documentation Milestone 4 * Final 150 organizations * Final deduplication and quality review * Completed Excel, Google Sheets-compatible, and CSV deliverables Total: 500 accepted organizations Payments will be released upon successful milestone acceptance. 7. Freelancer Qualifications Applicants must have experience in: * B2B lead generation and market research * Researching US-based organizations * Identifying business decision-makers * Professional email verification * LinkedIn and company website research * Excel or Google Sheets data management * CRM-ready data preparation Experience researching churches, healthcare organizations, accounting firms, or professional services is preferred. 8. Application Instructions To be considered, please answer the following questions: 1. Which tools do you use to research decision-makers and verify professional emails? 2. How do you identify and exclude catch-all email domains? 3. Can you guarantee that every accepted organization will have at least one qualifying verified decision-maker email? 4. Have you completed similar US-based B2B research projects? 5. Can you provide a redacted sample of your previous work? 6. What is your estimated completion time for 500 organizations? 7. Does your fixed-price bid include all email verification and research tool costs? Begin your proposal with “Texas Verified Leads” to confirm you have read the full project requirements. Generic proposals that do not address the email verification requirements will not be considered. We are looking for a reliable researcher who can become a long-term partner for future prospect research projects. Recommended Freelancer.com posting settings Setting Recommendation Project type Fixed Price Budget $450–$650 Skills Lead Generation, Market Research, Data Mining, Email Marketing, Excel, Web Research Experience Intermediate or Expert Project duration 10–15 business days Payment Four milestones, starting with paid pilot Freelancer location Worldwide, with demonstrated US B2B research experience Recommended award: Approximately $550, subject to the quality of proposals. Keep the initial 50-record pilot around $60–$75 and release additional milestones only after verification. One final point: the freelancer is responsible for research and data delivery only, not sending emails or managing campaigns. Keeping those separate allows you to review the data before importing it into GoHighLevel and launching outreach.

opportunities.description: BUMK Atelier Gelato, una marca de helados artesanales, busca un(a) creador(a) de contenido freelance, proactivo(a) y creativo(a) para gestionar y potenciar su presencia en Instagram y TikTok. El objetivo principal es aumentar la visibilidad y la interacción de la marca a través de contenido innovador y atractivo. Responsabilidades clave: - Desarrollar ideas originales y elaborar un calendario mensual de contenido para ambas plataformas. - Realizar visitas a nuestra fábrica y punto de venta en Bogotá para la grabación de videos y material visual. - Editar profesionalmente Reels, TikToks e historias, asegurando un estilo visual coherente con la marca. - Redactar textos persuasivos y creativos para las publicaciones, y gestionar la publicación de los contenidos aprobados. - Monitorear tendencias actuales en redes sociales y proponer nuevas estrategias para mejorar el alcance y el engagement de la marca. Buscamos un(a) profesional con experiencia comprobada en creación de contenido para marcas, un excelente gusto visual, alta iniciativa y capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma. Se valorará la habilidad para proponer, planificar y aportar ideas que contribuyan al crecimiento de la marca. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Community Management ¿Qué necesitas?: Pocas publicaciones por semana o marca en crecimiento

opportunities.title: WordPress Form Automation via n8n
opportunities.description: I need an example of your old work, maybe one that you've automated before.If you don't have an example, don't send a proposal. I need an n8n workflow that catches every submission from my WordPress forms and pushes the data straight into the external services I specify—no manual exports, no copy-paste. The form plugin could be Contact Form 7, WPForms, or Elementor Forms; I simply want whatever is on the site now to fire a webhook that n8n can listen to. Once a submission arrives, the workflow should parse the payload, clean or transform fields when needed, then forward the data to the destination tool I choose (Google Sheets, Gmail, HubSpot, or any API-based app I define later). A short Loom or text walkthrough of how you built it and where I can adjust endpoints will be the final touch so I can maintain it myself. Deliverables: • Working n8n workflow file (or direct setup on my n8n instance) • Connection test showing a live form submission reaching the external service • Brief hand-off guide or video explaining edits, field mapping, and error handling If you’re fluent in WordPress webhooks, REST API calls, and n8n nodes, this should be quick. Let me know any clarification you need so we can get the automation running smoothly.

opportunities.title: Ultra-Slim PCB Enclosure Design
opportunities.description: I need an experienced product or mechanical designer to create an enclosure that keeps my small PCB board as thin as physically possible. It is for a hospital product worn by a nurse. I have included a sample idea. The board will sit inside a handheld / wearable device, so every fraction of a millimetre counts for comfort in a pocket or against the body. I WOULD LIKE TO MAKE THE FINISHED PRODUCT AS THIN AS POSSIBLE. CHANGING THE WAY THE BATTERY IS INSTALLED COULD REDUCE THE THICKNESS OF THE DEVICE. The battery currently determines teh minimum thickness. MAYBE A HOLE IN THE PCB FOR THE BATTERY? I also NEED ADVICE ON THE LOCKING MECHANISM OR HOW TO CONNECT THE TWO PIECES TOGETHER. four screws? one screw? battery will need to be changed on occasion. also there is a place for a light on the board that will need corresponding hole and also a place where a vibration device needs to sit and contact the board. There is no styling overhaul required—the priority is compressing overall thickness without sacrificing component clearances, thermal safety or structural integrity. A clever internal stacking strategy, material selection suited to thin-wall moulding, and thoughtful connector access are all aspects I expect you to balance. Rapid turnaround is critical; I’d like initial concepts immediately and a manufacturable model right after approval. Deliverables • 3D CAD files (STEP or SolidWorks) ready for injection-moulding or high-resolution printing • Dimensioned drawings highlighting wall thicknesses, tolerances and assembly method • A brief report on material choice and any cooling or reinforcement features If you have proven work in ultra-compact consumer electronics enclosures and can start right away, let’s make this happen.

opportunities.title: Night Drive Product Art: Phone Case Design, Packaging & 3 Ad Posts (Must Match Our Existing Pixel-Art Animation)
opportunities.description: We're Techs, a hardware product studio. Our first product, Graby, is a premium iPhone 15 case with a small screen on the back that plays a looping animation, plus art printed on the case itself. The whole product is built around one idea: self-expression. THE IDEA: A "THEME" Every Graby is sold as a complete Theme: one story told through everything the customer sees and touches. The animation on the screen is already finished. We now need the printed case art, the box and the ads to feel like the same world, so the customer sees one story, not four separate designs. OUR FIRST THEME: NIGHT DRIVE Night Drive is about the double life of a car lover. When the sun goes down, the city becomes his track: neon reflections on wet asphalt, tires through a drift, rival headlights in the mirror. In the morning he's back to an ordinary, quiet life, waiting for dark. Our customer lives that same double life, so he should recognize himself in it. The night is the hero. The day appears only as a quiet contrast (a hint, a color shift, a silhouette). Mood: cinematic, energetic, premium. Not cartoonish, not childish, no cluttered racing-sticker look. Something a car lover wants to look at every day. THE ANIMATION (our starting point) The screen plays a looping pixel-art animation: a car drifting through a neon-lit city at night, with rain and spray, glowing billboards and deep blue and magenta tones. We'll send 2-3 still frames with the project. Your work must clearly belong to the same world: the same palette, mood, lighting and car. You don't need to make pixel art. Your work can be more detailed, as long as it feels like the next page of the same story. WHAT WE NEED 1) PHONE CASE ARTWORK (printed on the back of the case) - We'll send a flat print template (back panel, camera cutout, screen window, button positions, bleed) and renders of the case. - The animated screen sits at the top beside the camera. Design the artwork so the screen's glow feels like part of the illustration. - Think of it as a different moment of the same night as the animation: a different angle, a different spot in the city, or the same car after the drift. - Lighting should feel cinematic (light on wet surfaces, reflections, depth), not flat glowing outlines. - It's printed on a matte surface, so use deep dark base tones and print-friendly color that still pops. We'll confirm exact print specs with our printer. - It must look expensive on a desk and in the hand. - Deliver: print-ready layered file (300+ dpi, with bleed), a flat preview, and a mockup on the case. 2) PACKAGING The box has two jobs. Job 1, grab attention: make a stranger in a store stop and pick it up. It should stand out on a shelf from a few meters away and read in about 2 seconds, with one strong focal point, bold contrast and minimal text. Job 2, show what's inside: a shopper who has never heard of us should understand right away that this is a smart iPhone 15 case with a built-in screen that plays animated GIFs. Show it, don't only say it. For example, show the case with its screen lit up, plus one short, clear line in your own wording. Layout: - Front of the box: the case seen from its art side, where the main artwork and the glowing screen are visible. This is the night at full intensity. - Back of the box: the case seen from the side where the phone is housed, with the key features laid out cleanly. - Small, tidy feature strip at the bottom (not part of the main art): a note that you can upload your own GIFs, plus the other features we send you. - Inside the lid: your call (for example, a quiet hint of the "day" side of the story). We'll provide the box dimensions, dieline, product description and feature text. Finish ideas (spot UV, foil, emboss) are welcome if they're practical to print. - Deliver: print-ready artwork on the dieline plus a 3D mockup. 3) THREE SOCIAL MEDIA POSTS - Three clearly different posts about the same product, each a different story beat, each strong enough to run as a paid ad. - Suggested angles (improve them if you have better): (a) Two Lives: grey day vs. neon night; (b) The Race: rivals, drift, speed, with the case screen glowing; (c) The Detail: a close-up of the product with the screen alive against the dark city. - Formats: 1080x1350 (4:5), plus a 9:16 story crop of each. - We provide product renders. Copy should be short and minimal, in English. No spec lists: we sell stories, not specs. - Deliver: final PNG/JPG plus layered source files. RULES - Use whatever tools you like. The final work must be original and clearly art-directed by you, and must not look like stock, templates, or generic AI output. - You may use real car photos as reference for proportions, lighting and reflections. The car should stay consistent with the car in our animation. - Full copyright of all final work transfers to us on final payment. No posting the work publicly before our launch without written permission. A short confidentiality and copyright-transfer note will be signed with the final delivery. WE PROVIDE Techs logo (vector), still frames from the animation, flat print template and case renders, box dimensions and dieline, feature text, brand direction (dark, premium, never childish), and product renders. PROCESS: 10 DAYS MAXIMUM, 3 MILESTONES 1. By day 4: concept and case artwork. A short mood board, a color palette pulled from our animation, and the finished case artwork. 2. By day 7: packaging. 3. By day 10: the 3 posts, final revisions and all files delivered. Two revision rounds per deliverable are included. Please share work in progress at each milestone. BUDGET $100 total, fixed, paid by milestone: $40 / $35 / $25. TO APPLY 1. Links to 2-3 of your best pieces, including at least one packaging or key-art piece. 2. In 4-5 sentences: how would you carry the world of a neon night-drift animation into a phone case, a box and three ads? 3. The software you use, when you can start, and confirmation that you can deliver within 10 days.

opportunities.description: Necesito un diseñador que cree un folleto para promocionar un negocio o servicio. Solo requiero una pieza: incluirá nuestro logo, los datos de contacto y las redes sociales, presentados de forma clara y atractiva. Entrego el contenido textual y el archivo del logo; tú te encargas de la diagramación, la elección de tipografías y la propuesta de colores que mejor refuercen la imagen de marca. Entregables: • Folleto listo para imprimir en PDF alta resolución (tamaño A4 o carta, a una o dos caras según convenga). • Versión optimizada para redes sociales en formato JPG/PNG. • Archivo editable (AI, PSD o InDesign) para futuras actualizaciones. Busco un resultado limpio, profesional y fácil de leer. Si tienes ejemplos de trabajos similares, adjúntalos para evaluar tu estilo.

opportunities.title: Email Reminder Automation Tool
opportunities.description: I need a small desktop utility that takes the drudgery out of sending routine emails, messages, and reminders. The whole point is to automate a set of repetitive communication tasks that currently chew up my day, so the finished software must run locally (Windows or cross-platform if possible), trigger at scheduled times or events, and send the prepared content without further manual intervention. Core requirements • Desktop software or stand-alone automation script—no cloud subscription dependencies. • Primary function: automatically dispatch emails, text messages, or similar reminders I define. • Straightforward interface for adding, editing, and disabling scheduled messages. • Basic logging so I can verify what was sent and catch failures quickly. I am open on language and framework; Python (with SMTP libraries), C#, or even a lightweight Electron build would all work as long as setup is hassle-free. Please include the compiled application, readable source code, and a brief README that explains installation, configuration, and how to add or modify schedules. Clean, well-commented code and a quick turnaround will be the deciding factors.

opportunities.title: Website Penjualan Layanan Profesional
opportunities.description: Saya membutuhkan sebuah website lengkap untuk menjual jasa/layanan secara online. Fokus utamanya adalah konversi penjualan—pelanggan harus bisa menemukan informasi layanan, memilih paket, lalu langsung melakukan pembayaran dengan proses yang sederhana dan aman. Ruang lingkup inti: • Desain responsif yang tampak rapi di desktop maupun perangkat mobile. • Halaman beranda yang menyorot manfaat utama layanan, testimoni, dan call-to-action jelas. • Sistem katalog layanan: detail, harga, dan opsi pemesanan. • Keranjang dan checkout terintegrasi payment gateway populer di Indonesia (mis. Midtrans, Xendit, atau PayPal) dengan notifikasi transaksi otomatis. • Dashboard admin ramah-pakai untuk menambah atau mengubah layanan tanpa perlu coding. • Optimasi kecepatan dan SEO dasar agar mudah ditemukan calon klien. • Integrasi formulir kontak / chat (WhatsApp Web atau live chat) untuk tanya jawab cepat. • Panduan singkat cara penggunaan dashboard setelah website live. Saya terbuka pada stack yang Anda kuasai—WordPress + WooCommerce, Laravel, Next.js dengan headless CMS, atau solusi lain asalkan stabil dan mudah dipelihara. Mohon sertakan portofolio proyek serupa dan estimasi waktu pengerjaan.

opportunities.title: Toddler Song Video Production
opportunities.description: I already have original children’s songs recorded and ready for release on a new YouTube channel aimed at babies and toddlers (0-3 years). What I need now is a creative partner who can turn each track into a short, story-based video where the characters act out the lyrics in simple everyday situations—think mealtime, bath time, or getting ready for bed. You will receive: • The mastered audio track for each song. • Character artwork and reference poses you can freely adapt or rig. Your task is to animate those characters so the story flows naturally with the music. Bright colours, gentle motion, big expressions, and clear visual cues are essential for this age group. I’m open to whichever toolset you’re most comfortable with—After Effects, Toon Boom, Blender, or other 2-D/3-D pipelines—as long as the final export is YouTube-ready (1080p, H.264, AAC audio). For each video, please deliver: 1. A full-length MP4 synced perfectly with the song. 2. A thumbnail that instantly signals “fun and safe for toddlers.” 3. The working project files so I can request tweaks or translations later. If you love bringing simple stories to life and can keep a consistent, engaging style across multiple songs, let’s talk timelines and milestones.

opportunities.title: Modern Kitchen Cabinet Design Based on Existing Space and Measurements
opportunities.description: ### Project Description I am looking for an experienced kitchen designer or interior designer to create a modern, functional, and aesthetically appealing kitchen cabinet design based on the actual dimensions and photographs of an existing space. The kitchen area is currently unfinished, and the plumbing and electrical installations are already partially in place. The design must carefully consider the existing layout, wall dimensions, structural irregularities, and utility connection points. I will provide: - Photographs of the actual kitchen space. - A hand-drawn sketch showing the approximate dimensions and wall layout. - Available information about plumbing and electrical connection points. ### Scope of Work The selected freelancer will be responsible for: 1. Developing a modern kitchen cabinet layout that makes the best use of the available space. 2. Designing an appropriate combination of upper cabinets, lower cabinets, drawers, and storage units. 3. Creating an ergonomic and practical kitchen layout based on standard kitchen design principles. 4. Considering the existing plumbing, electrical outlets, and other technical constraints. 5. Selecting suitable cabinet materials, finishes, colors, and hardware. 6. Creating realistic, high-quality 3D visualizations of the proposed design. ### Required Deliverables - 2D kitchen cabinet layout with dimensions. - Detailed front elevations of all cabinet sections. - 3D photorealistic renderings from multiple viewpoints. - Material and color specifications. - Cabinet dimensions and technical details. - Construction-ready drawings suitable for cabinet manufacturing and installation. ### Design Requirements - Modern and minimalist aesthetic. - Maximum utilization of available space. - Practical storage solutions. - Ergonomic cabinet heights and depths. - Accurate consideration of the existing room dimensions and utility connections. - A design that is technically feasible and suitable for actual construction. ### Important Notes The attached photographs and measurements are provided as the initial design reference. The freelancer must review the available information carefully and identify any missing measurements before finalizing the design. Please include relevant examples of your previous kitchen cabinet design projects in your proposal. I am looking for a professional designer who can deliver both an attractive visual concept and technically accurate, practical drawings.

opportunities.title: SAP Instant Bidding Tool Development
opportunities.description: I need a small Windows-based utility that log into the my Server (SAP) freight tender portal, waits for a chosen contract to open, and fires our pre-calculated bid the very first millisecond the system allows it. The site awards freight lanes strictly on a first-come-first-served basis, so raw speed and rock-solid reliability matter more than anything else. How I picture the workflow • I enter one or more contract numbers and their ready-made prices (CSV or an on-screen table is fine). • The tool authenticates with our usual SAP credentials, keeps the session alive, and monitors the status of each contract. • The exact moment bidding goes live it submits the stored price, confirms acceptance, and logs the server timestamp so we can prove our place in line. • If the bid fails or the site throws a captcha/timeout, the software should retry instantly with sensible back-off rules and alert me. Technical notes • Must run on Windows 10/11. • I did not lock the build to any one language or technique; browser automation (Selenium, Playwright, etc.), direct API calls, or a hybrid approach are all acceptable as long as they hit the speed target. Feel free to recommend what you believe will shave off the most milliseconds. • Include a simple UI that lets my team load new contracts without touching code, plus a log file we can export. • Source code and a brief setup guide are part of the hand-off. Acceptance criteria 1. From the instant the “bid” button appears to confirmed submission must average <1 s on a 50 ms network latency test. 2. Successful bid placement is confirmed in My Server's own dashboard and recorded in the local log. 3. No sensitive credentials are stored in plain text. If you have already tackled similar high-speed bidding or ticket-grabber projects, I’d love to hear how you beat latency and session issues.

How I picture the workflow • I enter one or more contract numbers and their ready-made prices (CSV or an on-screen table is fine). • The tool authenticates with our usual SAP credentials, keeps the session alive, and monitors the status of each contract. • The exact moment bidding goes live it submits the stored price, confirms acceptance, and logs the server timestamp so we can prove our place in line. • If the bid fails or the site throws a captcha/timeout, the software should retry instantly with sensible back-off rules and alert me. Technical notes • Must run on Windows 10/11. • I did not lock the build to any one language or technique; browser automation (Selenium, Playwright, etc.), direct API calls, or a hybrid approach are all acceptable as long as they hit the speed target. Feel free to recommend what you believe will shave off the most milliseconds. • Include a simple UI that lets my team load new contracts without touching code, plus a log file we can export. • Source code and a brief setup guide are part of the hand-off. Acceptance criteria 1. From the instant the “bid” button appears to confirmed submission must average <1 s on a 50 ms network latency test. 2. Successful bid placement is confirmed in My Server's own dashboard and recorded in the local log. 3. No sensitive credentials are stored in plain text. If you have already tackled similar high-speed bidding or ticket-grabber projects, I’d love to hear how you beat latency and session issues."

opportunities.title: Perfect My 3D Print Model
opportunities.description: I already have a nearly finished 3D model, but some of the finer points still look a bit off once I preview it for printing. I’d like you to give the file a professional polish—paying closest attention to realistic scale, wall-thickness, and overall proportions so the final piece feels believable in the hand and prints cleanly on consumer-grade FDM or resin machines. You’ll start from my current file (I can supply it in STL) I don’t expect major overhauls to the overall shape; instead, I want subtle but critical tweaks that bring the model up to production quality without drifting from my original design intent. I will also provide the refernece images Deliverables: • Revised, print-ready model in the same format I provide, plus an STL. • A short note summarising the adjustments you made and any print-orientation or support suggestions. If you think a quick test slice or thickness report would help confirm the changes, feel free to include it—I’m happy to review.

opportunities.title: AI-Powered Time Machine Simulator
opportunities.description: Project Title ChronoAI: AI-Powered Time Machine Simulation and Automated Future Prediction System 1. Role Act as an expert AI engineer, automation developer, machine learning researcher, and futuristic system designer. 2. Context Develop an intelligent AI automation system called ChronoAI that simulates a time machine using artificial intelligence. The system allows users to explore historical events, simulate alternative decisions, predict possible future scenarios, and automate actions based on predicted outcomes. The system does not physically travel through time. Instead, it uses AI, historical datasets, predictive models, and interactive simulations to recreate past scenarios and estimate possible futures. 3. Main Objectives - Simulate historical events using available historical information. - Predict possible future outcomes using machine learning. - Allow users to change selected past-event variables in hypothetical simulations. - Compare actual historical outcomes with alternative scenarios. - Automate scenario generation and report creation. - Provide an interactive time-travel interface. 4. Core Features A. Time Machine Interface Create a futuristic interface containing: - A timeline from the past to the future. - A date and year selector. - A virtual time-travel button. - A historical-event explorer. - A future-scenario simulator. B. AI Past Explorer Allow users to select a historical period and explore: - Major historical events. - Scientific discoveries. - Technological developments. - Important people and civilizations. Use reliable historical datasets and sources. C. Future Prediction Engine Use machine learning to analyze selected datasets and estimate possible future scenarios. Example applications: - Climate trends. - Population growth. - Technology adoption. - Economic trends. Clearly communicate uncertainty and avoid presenting predictions as guaranteed outcomes. D. Alternative Timeline Generator Allow users to change hypothetical conditions. Example: - What if the internet had been invented 50 years earlier? - What if a particular scientific discovery had happened sooner? - What if a city had invested in renewable energy 20 years ago? Generate alternative timelines and explain how the changed assumptions might affect the simulated outcomes. E. AI Automation Engine Automate: - Data collection from approved sources. - Data preprocessing. - Prediction generation. - Timeline visualization. - Scenario comparisons. - PDF report generation. F. Futuristic Dashboard Create a dashboard with: - A glowing timeline. - Animated time-travel effects. - Historical and future event cards. - Interactive charts. - Before-and-after scenario comparisons. - AI-generated explanations. 5. Technology Stack - Python - Machine learning: Scikit-learn - Data processing: Pandas and NumPy - Visualization: Plotly - Interface: Streamlit - AI models: Suitable language models and predictive models - Automation: Python scheduling and workflow tools - Database: SQLite 6. Expected Output Build a functional prototype that allows users to select a year, explore historical information, modify hypothetical conditions, generate simulated future scenarios, and compare alternative timelines. Provide the complete source code, project structure, installation instructions, sample dataset, system architecture, and testing results. 7. Development Rules - Build a working simulation rather than claiming to create a real time machine. - Distinguish verified historical facts from fictional scenarios. - Explain the assumptions behind each prediction. - Never fabricate historical evidence or experimental results. - Design the system so that additional AI models and automation features can be added later.

opportunities.title: 10-Second Smooth Pop Roblox Emote
opportunities.description: I’m putting together a new set of animations for my Roblox experience and need a single, polished dance emote in a smooth pop style. The move set should last about ten seconds, loop cleanly, and capture the vibe you’ll see in the short reference video I’ll send right after we start. Think light-footed, catchy, and fluid—something players will want to trigger over and over. You’re free to build the animation in Blender, the Roblox Animation Editor, Moon Animator, or any tool you’re comfortable with, as long as the final result imports perfectly into Roblox Studio and plays on the standard R15 rig without distortions. Deliverables • Finished dance animation file (.fbx or .rbxmx) that loops at exactly ~10 s • Exported keyframe sequence ready to upload through Roblox Studio • One quick screen-capture preview (MP4 or GIF) so I can confirm timing and feel before we publish I’ll handle testing in-game once I receive the files; please leave the joints and naming conventions untouched to avoid re-mapping. If everything syncs to the reference mood and loops seamlessly, we’re good to go. Looking forward to seeing your smooth pop moves come to life!

opportunities.title: Manual Free Fire Match Moderator
opportunities.description: I run a Free Fire eSports app (Shahenshah eSports) and need a dedicated team of 4 to 5 human moderators to manage our daily tournament schedule manually. No AI tools, bots, or automation are acceptable. We host multiple match formats including Battle Royale (BR), Clash Squad (CS), and Lone Wolf matches, running simultaneously throughout the day. Your shifting/work routine: • The team must cover the full schedule from 10:00 AM in the morning until 11:00 PM at night (13 Hours daily coverage). • Together, the staff will handle around 50 matches per day across different game modes. Your exact duties: 1. Manually create Free Fire custom rooms (BR, CS, or Lone Wolf) from your devices. 2. Instantly copy and paste the correct Room ID & Password into our app's Admin Dashboard before matches start. 3. Track the matches and ensure proper spectator coordination. 4. Take a clear screenshot of the final endgame scoreboard/result screen for every match. 5. Log each player's exact kills and final placement rank back into our dashboard promptly for real-time results. A rock-solid internet connection, extreme attention to detail, and proper devices to handle Free Fire are strictly required. Please let me know your monthly rate or per-day rate for a team of 4-5 moderators, and when you can start.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40806453, publicado hace 15 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 12,500 - 37,500.

opportunities.title: Exact PDF-to-CAD Conversion
opportunities.description: I need an architectural plan that currently exists only as a PDF recreated in CAD so it mirrors the original drawing line-for-line and at the identical scale. Every wall, door, window, dimension string, keynote, symbol, hatch pattern, and title block from the PDF must appear in the DWG exactly as shown, fully editable and ready to plot without any further tweaks. The plan is already fully dimensioned, so those dimensions—as well as all notes and symbols—have to be transferred, not retyped as static text. Use proper CAD text and dimension styles so the file remains clean and easy for me to modify later. Layering is fine as long as print colours and lineweights stay true to the PDF. Deliverables • One AutoCAD-compatible DWG (2018 or earlier) matching the PDF’s layout and scale • A quick PDF plotted from the DWG for visual cross-check I’ll provide the source PDF immediately after we start and will be available for any questions while you work. Accuracy is paramount; please double-check dimensions before hand-off so I can move straight into project coordination once I receive the file.

opportunities.description: Freelance 3D Artist Required – Furniture & Interior Modelling Project: ModuMitra – 3D Furniture & Interior Object Library We are looking for an experienced freelance 3D Artist to create high-quality, dimensionally accurate 3D models of furniture and interior products for our web-based interior design and modular furniture software. Preferred Skills * Blender * Autodesk 3ds Max * SketchUp * Three.js / WebGL knowledge (additional advantage) * Experience in furniture or architectural modelling. Important This is not just a rendering project. We need production-ready 3D assets that can be integrated into our software, where users can customize furniture dimensions, finishes and configurations. Engagement: Freelance / Project-based, with potential for long-term collaboration. To Apply: Please share: 1. Your portfolio of furniture and interior 3D models. 2. Software and tools you use. 3. Estimated cost per 3D model or asset. 4. Estimated turnaround time. 5. Examples of models optimized for web-based 3D applications. We are looking for reliable freelancers interested in building a long-term association with an innovative interior technology platform.

opportunities.title: Especialista en Ethical hacking y Blindaje de VPS
opportunities.description: Estamos buscando un ingeniero senior en ciberseguridad y hacking ético de habla hispana (preferiblemente ubicado en España o franja horaria compatible) con un fuerte perfil de ingeniería de sistemas y mentalidad de agencia. Actualmente gestionamos una infraestructura crítica en un servidor VPS que aloja 17 aplicaciones dockerizadas, páginas web con wordpress, html y Astro, además de flujos de automatización en n8n. Requerimos un profesional con experiencia real y contrastada para auditar, blindar y establecer un sistema de monitorización y recuperación ante desastres continuo. Aviso importante: No leemos propuestas automáticas ni generadas por IA. Si aplicas, por favor detalla brevemente un caso real donde hayas solucionado un incidente crítico o securizado un entorno de múltiples contenedores Docker en producción. "Empieza tu mensaje con la palabra 'CIBER-2026'". Fase 1: Alcance del Desarrollo Inicial - Hardening Integral de Servidor y Contenedores: Blindaje de Linux (baseline CIS), políticas de red, gestión segura de secretos, permisos de sockets de Docker y aislamiento de los 17 contenedores activos en el VPS. - Backup escalado del servidor con s3 para una recuperación en caso de infección o ataque. - Configuración de cloudflare. - Auditoría de Aplicaciones (Generadas por IA y Web): Revisión de vulnerabilidades lógicas, validación de OWASP Top 10 y revisión de código/APIs en las apps alojadas. - Arquitectura de Resiliencia y Disaster Recovery: Diseño e implementación de un sistema de copias de seguridad automatizadas, cifradas y probadas (política 3-2-1) con capacidad de recuperación inmediata (RTO/RPO mínimo) ante caídas o ataques. - Monitorización y Alertas de Intrusión (SIEM/IDS básico): Configuración de observabilidad en tiempo real ante accesos no autorizados, anomalías de recursos o intentos de vulneración (Fail2ban, logs centralizados y alertas por webhook). - Optimización de n8n: Recomendación técnica y reestructuración de las automatizaciones de n8n para garantizar aislamiento por cliente, rendimiento óptimo y escalabilidad de recursos en el VPS. Fase 2: Colaboración Continua (White-Label) Una vez blindado y estabilizado nuestro entorno interno, la relación evolucionará a un acuerdo a largo plazo donde el candidato actuará como nuestro partner técnico de ciberseguridad para clientes finales. Requerimos: - Su catálogo de servicios técnicos con precios netos de partner. - Su tarifa por hora como colaborador externo para incidencias o mantenimientos. - Tiempos de respuesta (SLA) y disponibilidad acordados. - Firmar un NDA o acuerdo de confidencialidad. - Disponibilidad de entrevista por videollamada antes de iniciar el proyecto. Requisitos Indispensables: - Habla hispana nativa (España o LATAM con excelente encaje horario). - Experiencia demostrable en seguridad ofensiva/defensiva, Linux avanzado, Docker, PostgreSQL y Nginx. - Transparencia, rigor técnico y capacidad para dar la cara de forma telemática ante clientes de la agencia. Para aplicar: Demuestra tu experiencia respondiendo directamente a nuestra arquitectura técnica actual y adjunta tus tarifas de partner.

opportunities.title: Edición Video Vertical Creativo
opportunities.description: Tengo varias grabaciones de videos hablando a cámara que necesito convertir en un contenido vertical pulido y listo para publicar en Instagram y TikTok. Te enviaré el material en bruto y espero que, con criterio editorial, construyas un video fluido: corta repeticiones y silencios, reorganiza las ideas para que mantengan coherencia y ajusta el ritmo para que el mensaje se entienda sin esfuerzo. El archivo final deberá incluir subtítulos incrustados con palabras clave grandes y animadas que resalten los conceptos centrales. También confío en ti para limpiar el audio, corregir color cuando sea necesario y dejar la pieza lista para usarse tal cual, en 1080 × 1920 px, preferiblemente en .mp4. Si tienes experiencia editando verticales para redes y dominas herramientas como Premiere Pro, Final Cut o DaVinci Resolve, envíame enlaces a trabajos similares, dime cuánta disponibilidad tienes y tu tarifa por este tipo de proyecto. Espero tu propuesta para empezar cuanto antes.

opportunities.title: Enhanced Facial Rig & Animation
opportunities.description: I have a fully modelled and generally well-rigged human character, but the face is letting the whole performance down. What I need now is a specialist who can breathe life into the facial rig so that it delivers convincing lip sync and the four key emotions—happy, sad, angry, and surprised—without the mesh collapsing or stretching unnaturally. The body controls, weights, and IK chains are already in good shape, so your attention can stay on the head: refining skin weights around the jaw, cheeks, and eyes; adding or polishing blend-shapes/shape keys for phonemes; and making sure the controls are intuitive enough for quick animation passes. Feel free to work in Maya, Blender, or any other mainstream package as long as you can hand back an FBX and the native file. I will supply: • The current rigged model (native file + FBX) • A short test audio clip for lip-sync evaluation • Turntable reference video of the existing deformation issues Deliver back to me: • Updated rig with clean, labeled facial controls • A short test animation that hits the supplied audio and shows all four emotions • Clear notes on anything I should know to keep the rig stable in production Acceptance criteria: • Jaw, lips, and cheeks follow audio naturally with no obvious mesh collapse • Happy, sad, angry, and surprised poses read clearly from every camera angle • No new skinning artifacts introduced elsewhere on the model If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let’s get started—I’m ready to drop the files to you right away.

opportunities.title: Diseño Arquitectónico de Casa Mediterránea de un Piso
opportunities.description: Se busca un arquitecto o diseñador con experiencia para crear el diseño completo de una casa de estilo mediterráneo de un solo piso. La vivienda debe estar optimizada para dos adultos y un bebé, priorizando la funcionalidad, la comodidad y la seguridad. El diseño debe incluir una distribución eficiente de los espacios, considerando áreas comunes, dormitorios y zonas de servicio, manteniendo la estética característica del estilo mediterráneo. Se valorará la creatividad en la propuesta de soluciones para un entorno familiar con un bebé. Piscina, ante jardin, cerco vivo, etc. Terminaciones de gama alta. opportunities.title: Redacción Técnica Ingeniería Química
opportunities.description: Busco apoyo en Ingeniería química escritorios o secretaria para redactar informes o documentos técnicos. Necesito que tomes la información que yo suministre (datos de proceso, fichas de equipos, parámetros de operación o normativa aplicable) y la transformes en reportes claros, bien estructurados y con lenguaje profesional, listos para presentar a gerencia y autoridades regulatorias. Alcance principal • Redactar y dar formato a los documentos técnicos según mis plantillas o, si lo prefieres, proponer un esquema de secciones lógico y coherente. • Verificar la consistencia de cifras, unidades y referencias bibliográficas. • Incluir tablas, diagramas simples o gráficos de datos cuando sean necesarios para respaldar los argumentos. • Entregar archivos editables (Word o equivalente) y versión PDF final. Valoraré experiencia previa elaborando reportes en ingeniería química, dominio de terminología específica y atención a los detalles de estilo y ortografía. Si manejas herramientas como MS Office, Google Workspace o software de diagramación básica (Visio, Lucidchart), menciónalo en tu propuesta. Indícame tu método de trabajo, plazos estimados y ejemplos de documentos similares que hayas preparado. Tengo material listo para comenzar en cuanto definamos el cronograma.

opportunities.title: Cerrador Telefónico Páginas Web
opportunities.description: Necesito un profesional con experiencia en llamadas en frío y cierre de ventas para vender directamente nuestras páginas web a clientes. Entregaré una Lista de contactos que aún no conoce nuestro producto o servicio, siendo tu misión presentarles los beneficios y vender nuestras páginas web durante la misma llamada. Qué harás: - Realizar llamadas a cada prospecto de nuestra lista, despertar su interés y exponer claramente los beneficios de contar con una página web profesional. - Manejar objeciones, negociar condiciones y cerrar la venta en la misma interacción o mediante un seguimiento cercano. - Mantener un registro preciso en CRM (o en Excel si prefieres) sobre el estado de cada contacto, incluyendo comentarios relevantes y resultados. Lo que necesito: - Ratio consistente en el cierre de ventas directas. - Reportes claros con estadísticas e ideas para mejorar continuamente el proceso según patrones observados. Idealmente, busco alguien que ya cuente con experiencia comprobada en telesales B2B y que domine herramientas como HubSpot o similares. Si disfrutas persuadir por teléfono y cerrar negocios con éxito, ¡postula ahora!

Si ya tienes experiencia cerrando servicios vía chat y puedes empezar de inmediato, hablemos.

opportunities.title: Querétaro - Evaluar atención y servicio de manera presencial -- 7
opportunities.description: La actividad consiste en pedir información y solicitar una cotización de manera presencial en una empresa asignada por nosotros. Para realizar satisfactoriamente la actividad se requiere de lo siguiente: 1. Estudiar guía proporcionada por nosotros, comprender lo que se requiere mencionar y lo que se requiere cotizar, tener comunicación con nosotros por este medio antes de iniciar la actividad para aclarar el objetivo y resolver cualquier duda. (Tiempo aproximado 1 hora, de la cual son 30 minutos de estudio de guía y 30 minutos para resolver dudas). 2. Presentarse en la empresa y sucursal asignada para recibir explicación personal del servicio y confirmación de cotización. (Tiempo aproximado 30 minutos + el traslado) 5. Enviarnos la cotización recibida por correo electrónico y un formulario de evaluación (Tiempo aproximado 30-60 minutos). En total se requieren de 3 a 4 horas para completar la actividad, el pago es fijo y es de $50 USD una vez que la actividad fue completada satisfactoriamente. Requerimientos del Freelancer: A. Vivir en la ciudad de Querétaro. B. Contar con medio de transporte (auto o motocicleta). C. Edad mínima 25 años. D. Contar con un smartphone con Android y/o iOS y tener la app de Freelancer instalada en su teléfono móvil con las notificaciones activadas. (Una de las principales causas de que los proyectos no se logren satisfactoriamente es debido a que los Freelancers no están al pendiente de sus mensajes o no reciben las notificaciones causando una comunicación tardía, por este motivo te pedimos instalar la app y estar al tanto de la misma para beneficio de todos). Si te interesa participar en esta actividad y no has hecho la misma anteriormente realiza tu bid por la cantidad fija $50 USD y escribiendo en el mensaje el municipio en el que vives para confirmar que no eres un bot. Bids por cantidades mayores a $50 USD no serán considerados. Se contratarán varios shoppers para esta actividad. Gracias.

opportunities.title: Finalizar App de Auditorías
opportunities.description: Estoy desarrollando una aplicación de auditorías en Microsoft Power Apps con listas de SharePoint ya creadas y necesito ayuda remota para terminarla. Mi prioridad inmediata es el diseño de pantallas y la navegación: quiero pantallas claras donde el usuario pueda crear y completar una nueva auditoría, avanzando por una lista de preguntas con opciones de respuesta predeterminadas. Además, requiero: • Configurar el registro automático de fecha y hora en cada auditoría. • Ajustar la lógica de guardado y validación de datos en SharePoint. • Dejar preparada la conexión para que los resultados se visualicen más adelante en Power BI. En tu propuesta indícame: • Experiencia concreta con Power Apps y SharePoint (menciona ejemplos similares). • Disponibilidad horaria para sesiones remotas. • Tarifa por hora y estimación aproximada para finalizar el proyecto. Busco a alguien que conozca bien colecciones, formularios, galerías, Power Automate y que pueda explicarme brevemente las decisiones de diseño para que el mantenimiento futuro sea sencillo. Si tienes dashboards en Power BI conectados a Power Apps, comparte enlaces o capturas. Espero tu mensaje y ejemplos para empezar cuanto antes.

opportunities.title: Editor de video
opportunities.description: Estoy lanzando una agencia de contenidos en la que yo me encargaré de atraer y gestionar a los clientes; tu misión será transformar su material bruto en piezas impactantes. Qué necesito de ti • Dominio comprobable en Shorts, Reels y demás videos verticales para redes sociales. • Experiencia sólida en podcasts y videos horizontales para YouTube. • Habilidad para editar gameplays, crear animaciones y agregar efectos visuales. Estilo deseado Mis clientes buscan un acabado creativo y llamativo, con animaciones, efectos y diseño personalizado que capte la atención de inmediato. El ritmo debe ser ágil y entretenido, pero sin sacrificar claridad ni buena mezcla de audio. Flujo de trabajo 1. Recibirás briefing y archivos fuente. 2. Propondrás la estructura y los recursos visuales. 3. Ajustaremos detalles hasta que el resultado quede listo para publicar. Requisitos • Portafolio actualizado que demuestre proyectos similares. • Comunicación rápida: la mayoría de encargos se entregarán lo más pronto posible. • Disponibilidad para colaborar de forma continua y cumplir plazos exigentes. Si te entusiasma crear contenidos que destaquen en redes y quieres crecer con un flujo constante de proyectos, envíame tu reel, tarifas orientativas y datos de contacto. Estoy deseando contar con tu talento.
